subject: WRITE statement
notes: SR4: 'If identifier-1 is a function-identifier, it shall reference an alphanumeric or national function.' (--check OK). FromPhraseRules.Write = {Alphanumeric, National}; BindFromPhrase reads the function's category through MoveTable16.SenderPosition (so a constant-folded LENGTH still reads numeric) and raises COBOL1914. Same row serves the sequential and keyed arms. Probes: numeric (NUMVAL), integer (INTEGER, LENGTH) and boolean (BOOLEAN-OF-INTEGER) rejected 1914; alphanumeric (UPPER-CASE, CURRENT-DATE) and national (NATIONAL-OF to PIC N) accepted. The screen is deliberately not applied to an inline method invocation (not a function-identifier, §8.4.3.1.2). pb348-write-from-integer-function rejects FUNCTION LENGTH at all four editions; the paired positive is conformance:cases/8.4.3.1-Identifier/pb10_function_identifier_sending. [editions as adjudicated: 1985, 2002, 2014, 2023 wherever a function-identifier can be written as identifier-1 (the national/boolean categories are post-1985)]
